create.name: Lisa Rafel
create.bio:
Before she became a spiritual teacher and sound healer, Lisa Rafel worked as an actress, playwright, songwriter and producer. The American teacher is known for Vocal Sound Healing™, which uses the voice, chant and overtones for self-healing and in work with others, and she has taught vocal sound for more than thirty years. Guided meditation, prayer, energy exercises and psychic "seeing" all feature in her classes, shaped by Kabbalah and by Tibetan, Mongolian, ancient Egyptian and Native American practices. She has sung at Chartres Cathedral, the Great Pyramid and Tibet's Sakya Monastery.

Her live online teaching happens in small groups. The Five Worlds is a two-day programme passing through five thresholds towards a more integrated sense of self; alongside it run Psychic Wisdom, Vocal Sound Healing classes and small ongoing groups she calls pods. She is on the faculty of The Shift Network and the Globe Sound Healing Institute, and also teaches at Rancho La Puerta in Mexico. Lisa's World, her low-cost membership, holds a library of her meditations, prayers and talks. Through her company Resonant Sounds, and with Gary Malkin and her husband David Surrenda, she co-created Safe in the Arms of Love, a book and music set on parent and baby bonding.

books.title: It began in Kathmandu
books.author: Lisa Rafel
books.description: A photo journal with poetry in which Lisa Rafel recounts the spiritual awakening she experienced in Nepal. It was first published in 1990 by Prometheus Press in a small print run.

courses.title: The Five Worlds: A Path to Integration
courses.description: A two-day live online programme for a small group, moving through five "worlds" or thresholds with meditation, visualisation, reflection and energy exercises. It works on boundaries, balance, creativity and intuitive perception, with materials provided afterwards.
courses.price: $390 USD (early registration before 14 February); $440 USD after

courses.title: Psychic Wisdom
courses.description: A three-hour small-group online class on intuitive "seeing" without judgement, for insight into yourself and your relationships. No previous experience is needed; 2027 dates are still to be announced.
courses.price: $130 USD ($115 USD for Lisa's World members and returning students)

courses.title: Lisa's World Membership
courses.description: An annual membership giving anytime access to Lisa's library of recorded meditations, breathing practices, prayers, poetry and talks. Members are also invited to her free online community gatherings during the year.

free_resources.title: Meditations, Exercises & Prayers
free_resources.description: A free collection of short guided meditations, grounding and breathing exercises and spoken prayers, several with piano by Gary Malkin. Most are under six minutes and can be played straight from the page.

free_resources.title: Teaching Stories and Talks
free_resources.description: Free short talks and teaching stories, including pieces on the inner warrior, the divine mother and father, and what spiritual awakening means. Each runs from three to eight minutes.
